## What it is

The other diameter. Two clips, one quarter-turn higher than the low cross, and the upper half of the lap. Same print pose as the low cross.

## Design notes

- Turned 90° from the low cross when assembled, so the four clips of a level are 90° apart and 5.75 mm apart in height.
- Its pin hole is round. The clocking flat is on the low cross. A flat here as well would fight the pin, because the flat's direction is this piece's thickness direction.
- The lap, not the hole, keeps it from spinning.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't add a clocking flat on the +Z face. That is the bed direction, and it clashes with the teardrop.
- Don't print it standing up.
